scope: external read/download/safe ZIP and Python static checks only; no Godot/install/current-repository modifications

api.retained: ModuleArchive.open_zip(path, expected_sha256); GenerationJob.create(request, library, config), advance(1..4096), progress(), is_done(), result(), cancel()
api.new: PreloadJob.create(path, expected_sha256) with shared WorkGate advance/progress/is_done/result/cancel/profile; PASS result.library is locked ModuleArchive
api.scheduling: One serial non-reentrant owner; one advance unit = 16 cooperative checkpoints, never a millisecond bound. result() duplicates dictionary deeply. Closing host must cancel job before releasing it.
api.fingerprint: Protocol.fingerprint canonicalizes request/config/library_sha256/implementation; algorithm and implementation change, keep actual new fingerprint.
api.schema_changes: config permits stable-v3-reward-space; map generator permits implementations 0.3.1 and 0.4.0; 0.4 Protocol.validate itself rejects non-v3 algorithm.

reward_check.method: Expand actual unconnected-port seal AABBs by player half-extents; check strict open-AABB union covers entire closed original reward region using critical x positions and interior slabs. Touching boundaries alone do not prove exclusion.
reward_check.all_sites: Transformed original compiled_content.reward_sites for every template, ordinary plus target rewards; no requiredRewards association filter. Mirroring/source bounds use existing content_transform.
reward_check.pruning: Reject/cache only proven complete exclusion in actual or prospective seal configurations; continue original candidate/budget search. Final audit repeats for every instance site. Partial search pruning is conservative; not a proof module is always unusable.
reward_check.unchanged: No reward relocation/removal, no opening unused ports, no module package bump, no seed/goal/scoring/budget change.

upstream_evidence_counts.scope: Counts recomputed from packaged upstream reports; no generation replay or Godot execution by this audit.

upstream_readiness_and_limits: claim grounding/path feasibility when not fully excluded
provenance_boundary: Use runtime_result admission for in-memory generated output. Actual result/map-data digests are data digests, not fabricated file SHA attestations. Module ZIP FileAccess SHA remains actual independent archive lock. Existing frozen file route and 0.3 locks stay separate.
host_adoption_boundary: New independent version/worktree and conformance generation are required. Never reuse 0.3 M IDs/selection/map_id/spawn/identity or its map-edit coverage table. Bind new actual output to new evidence before any host playability claim.
